name: ZCA_OBJECT_SHARE_REASON
description: This database table contains the reference to the Assignment Manager Rule Id that created the corresponding row in ZCA_OBJECT_SHARE. This row is interpreted as the reason an object share record was created. Functionally this represents the reason an access group was provided access to an object. In case such access was granted manually, this row will be created with a Rule Id of '-1'.

columns.name: OBJECT_SHARE_REASON_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the Object Share Reason (surrogate).

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_RULE_GROUP_ID
columns.description: This is used to store the Access Group Id which is referenced in the Assignment Manager Rule Candidate table to identify which Candidate was responsible for this Share.  This value will be -1 for manually created Shares

columns.name: OBJECT_SHARE_ID
columns.description: Reference to the Object Share for which this record was created.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Copied over from ZCA_OBJECT_SHARE so that this table may also be partitioned in the same lines as ZCA_OBJECT_SHARE. This table will be partitioned using the list partition scheme with this column as a the partition key.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_RULE_GUID
columns.description: Reference to the Assignment Manager Rule that was met, which led to creation of this share. This value will be -1 for manually created Shares.

columns.name: SRC_OBJECT_SHARE_REASON_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ZCA_OBJECT_SHARE_REASON record from the Source Object

columns.name: SRC_RELATIONSHIP_DN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ZCA_AG_RELATIONSHIP_DN record from the Source Object

columns.name: SRC_ACC_EXT_RULE_DN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ZCA_AG_ACC_EXT_RULE_DN  record from the Source Object

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_QUARTER
columns.description: Virtual Column used in partition along with Object Type.
